test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ‘Kalbelia’ is a folk-dance of which of the following states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​​The **folk dance** known as the **Kalbelia dance** is essential to the **Kalbelia culture**.
 
• Since the** Kalbelias** are recognized as traditional **snake charmers**, this dance is also referred to as the** Sapera dance.**
 
• Previously, this nomadic tribe would move from location to location **bartering snake venom.**
 
• The Kalbelia are a** snake-taming tribe** from** Rajasthan, India's Thar Desert.**
 
• **Men play** the instruments and give the music, but only **women perform** it.
 
• In **2010,** it was added to the list of** Intangible Cultural Heritage (ICH) **maintained by the **United Nations Educational, Scientific, and Cultural Organizations (UNESCO).**
 
• **Kathputli, Bhavai, Gair, Kachchhi Ghodi, Chang/Dhamal, Ghoomar and Terah Taali **are some other folk dances of Rajasthan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
